Clause 2 (withdrawal and reservation of the Sitka lands for the Coast and Geodetic Survey) is shown by held Public Land Order 6458 (48 FR 40232, effective 1983-09-06; jobs/selden-fr-acting/output/texts/FR_48_40232.txt) to have been cut back in 1983: a strip was deleted from the order and transferred to the Veterans Administration, and the remaining Lot 4 (117.13 acres) was transferred to the U.S. Geological Survey with a withdrawal that 'shall remain in effect for a period of 20 years from the effective date of this order', i.e. to about 2003-09-06. No held source shows an extension or renewal of that withdrawal to 2026-10-14. Also missing: the text of Proclamation 2965 (1952-02-25), which the Federal Register catalog says revoked the order in part, and of Public Land Order 1707 (1958-08-06). A YES claim cannot be supported; the held evidence points to the withdrawal having lapsed unless renewed.
